messages.content: Write a short email to my landlord asking them to fix the heating this week. Just the text, I'll send it myself.

arguments.command:
curl -s http://localhost:3333/pulse
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3333/recall -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"landlord heating"}'

content.text: Hi Sam, the heating has stopped working. Could someone fix it this week? Thanks, Alex

arguments.command:
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3333/feel -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"content":"Drafted a landlord email","feeling":"calm"}'
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3333/index-turn -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"source":"oneiro","content":"landlord email"}'
